policy_notes: Subdomain takeover: explicitly out-of-scope UNLESS actually proven claimable (policy says 'Unable to prove it can be taken over' is rejected) -- fingerprint-only hits are not enough, must demonstrate actual claim.

Cloud storage bucket leaks (S3/KSS/FDS): considered case-by-case on (a) whether access should be restricted and (b) sensitivity of exposed data -- a bare public listing with no sensitive content is unlikely to be rewarded.
Mainland China researchers must submit via sec.xiaomi.com instead of HackerOne -- not applicable to us, noted for completeness.
Missing security headers, DNS misconfig (MX/SPF), SSL/TLS cipher reports without PoC, autocomplete attribute, mixed content warnings: all explicitly out of scope.

'Edge business' / cooperative-manufacturer domains (e.g. imilab.com, zhimi.com, zmifi.com) are lower priority -- findings only count if they demonstrably affect Xiaomi, not just the third-party manufacturer.
Automated-scanner-only findings without manual reproduction risk being ignored or reduced in reward.
